title: Formal unramifiedness of a finite local model from its principal quotient
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], f in its maximal ideal, and r:F→Spec A finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. If its actual base change [def-pc-fibre-product] to Spec(A/(f)) is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], then r is formally unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. No flatness, depth, or punctured-cover hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Replace the finite source by the spectrum of its global sections, and transport the quotient hypothesis along the induced pullback isomorphism.

For a finite A-algebra B, the relative differential module is finite over A. The tensor-base-change isomorphism and vanishing of differentials of the etale quotient make (A/(f)) tensor Ω_{B/A} zero. The quotient-tensor isomorphism says Ω_{B/A}=(f)Ω_{B/A}. Nakayama, since (f) is contained in the maximal ideal, gives Ω_{B/A}=0. Translate this to formal unramifiedness of the original morphism. All these steps are implemented with Mathlib lemmas in the delivered Lean proof.
